records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Welcome to Wrenfield! Your workspace is ready. A good first step is to create your first project and invite a teammate.

If anything's unclear, just reply here.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no project, no invite, no key milestone, zero tickets, and no customer reply to either outreach (email:a8209e86, email:ce5a2d89). Kickoff was held (calendar:5a6b2be0), which is a mild positive signal, but silence plus zero product activity over 6 days suggests low unaided odds in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: Next step after our kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks again for making time for the kickoff last week. Since then I wanted to check in on getting your workspace moving.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating your first one is usually the quickest way to see how it fits your team. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you live.

Best,
Nadia
